records.mutant: replace match guard celebration with true in Router::send_bot
records.reason: A non-celebration reaches send_bot only at T0 or T2, where render makes exactly the calls push makes and answers the same outcome.
records.evidence: route gives a non-celebration the tier rendered(requested), and rendered answers only Tier::T0 or Tier::T2. At T0 render answers Outcome::Delivered(Tier::T0) with no call, and push answers Pushed::Delivered with no call, which delivered maps to Outcome::Delivered(Tier::T0). At T2 render answers delivered(bot.push_message(&PASS, text).await, Tier::T2), and push with a joined bot calls bot.push_message(&PASS, text) once, which the same delivered maps at Tier::T2. With no bot the guard is never read, since the arm matches Some(bot) only. send_bot has one caller, route; the flush renders through render directly.

records.reason: `>=` adds only `value % 100 == 10` to the `th` arm, and the other arm already yields `th` for it (10 % 10 == 0 falls to `_ => "th"`), so no input changes its label.
records.evidence: The unit test landmarks::tests::the_th_guard_and_the_match_arm_agree_at_the_ten_and_fourteen_edges measures both arms at 10, 14, 110 and 114: the `match value % 10` arm answers `th` at each, and ordinal_label answers 10th, 14th, 110th and 114th, the same label the guard arm gives. 11, 12, 13, 111, 112 and 113 stay `th` through the guard, whose match arm alone would not.
